transcript.text: Thanks, Dana. Let me address each item from the rights and sponsor agreement side. First, on sponsor display: the freestanding logo wall must be removed entirely. The sponsor's branding can only appear on reusable event cups and the festival website, so we need to redirect any sponsor visibility to those two channels. Second, on competitor brand marks: the agreement prohibits competitor product marks in the activation area, so participating food brands cannot display their marks at the activation. We'll need to either remove food brand marks from the activation area or seek an amendment from the sponsor's legal team if we want food brands to display their marks — but as the agreement currently stands, that's not permitted. On the food service format, number of stations, and allergen signage, those fall under Mei's operations and health permit review, so I'll defer to her on those points. I also want to note that I still need to enter my review results in the activation file — I'll do that as soon as we've agreed on the adjustments so the file reflects the final decisions.
